import sqlite3
import json

con = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')

def exec_val(sql):
    try:
        return con.execute(sql).fetchone()[0]
    except Exception as e:
        print("Error executing SQL:", sql)
        raise e

ans_reserve_assets = exec_val("SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-06-30'")
print(ans_reserve_assets)
ans_net_token_liability = exec_val("""
SELECT
  (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'gross contractual redemption' AND report_date='2025-06-30') -
  (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'company-held tokens not in Treasury wallet' AND report_date='2025-06-30')
""")
print(ans_net_token_liability)
ans_company_asset_excess = exec_val("""
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-06-30') -
  (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'detailed FFR company total liabilities' AND report_date='2025-06-30')
""")
print(ans_company_asset_excess)
ans_release_liability_delta = exec_val("""
SELECT
  (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'July release company total liabilities' AND report_date='2025-06-30') -
  (SELECT amount_usd FROM liability_inputs WHERE measure = 'detailed FFR company total liabilities' AND report_date='2025-06-30')
""")
print(ans_release_liability_delta)

EOF
